Variation of Condition No. 3 (Hours of operation) of planning permission Ref: P0315.24 dated 10/05/2024 to allow extended winter hours (Variation of Condition No. 1 of Planning Permission Ref: P0860.23 dated 18/04/2023 to vary the hours of operation from 08:00-17:00 Monday to Sunday during British Summer Time and 08:00-16:00 Monday to Sunday at all other times other than British Summer Time and Bank or Public Holidays, to 08:00-19:00 Monday to Friday during British Summer Time, 08:00-17:00 Saturday and Sunday during British Summer Time and 08:00-16:00 Monday to Sunday at all other times other than British Summer Time and Bank or Public Holidays. Not at any time on Bank or Public Holidays. (Following Grant of Appeal
APP/B5480/C/22/3290229 1. Without planning permission, the material change of use of the land to a dog walking business; and 2. Without planning permission, the installation of CCTV cameras,(Revised Description 26/4) )
